{text}
REQUEST>>>

target.instructions: The customer asks to delete something specific. Which single kind of item do they ask the shop to delete?

criteria.SEARCH_INDEX_ENTRY: A search result or search listing that shows them.
criteria.USER_EXPORT: A data export, download link or downloadable copy of their data.
criteria.SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT: A file they attached to a support request.
criteria.MARKETING_PROFILE: Their marketing or mailing-list contact record.
criteria.ANALYTICS_PROFILE: Analytics or tracking data about them.
criteria.SEVERAL_OR_UNCLEAR: Several kinds of data, the whole account, or the item is not clear.

whole_category.instructions: Does the customer ask to delete every item of that kind they have, rather than one particular item?

criteria.true: Asks to delete all items of that kind
criteria.false: Asks to delete one particular item, or does not say
